org.title: Organisation
org.hint: Your companies and their branches. Add a branch when you open a new shop; close one that is no longer used (its history stays).
org.currencyHint: Three letters, such as USD. It cannot be changed once the company has sales or postings.
org.currencyLocked: Fixed: this company already has postings. Add a new company to work in another currency.
org.timezoneHint: For example Europe/London. Business dates follow it.
org.firstBranchHint: A company needs a branch before it can sell or hold stock. You can add more later.
org.closeAsk: Close {{name}}? It will no longer be offered when choosing a branch, and no new tills or stores can be added to it. Its sales, stock and reports stay. You can reopen it later.
org.noneHint: You can manage companies here only with the right to do so.
